newsitem.title: USA: Graphic Industries sees Q2 EPS exceeding consensus.
newsitem.headline: Graphic Industries sees Q2 EPS exceeding consensus.

text.p: Graphic Industries Inc said Tuesday it expected to report second-quarter earnings that exceeded analysts' consensus estimate of $0.22 per share.
The company issued the forecast in a statement disclosing it had signed a letter of intent to acquire Graphic Technologies Inc, a Fort Lauderdale, Fla., printing company.
Terms of the proposed acquisition, the third by Graphic Industries in seven weeks, were not disclosed.
In the second quarter last year, Graphic Industries posted net income of $0.21 per share.
For the first quarter this year, the commercial printing company reported net income of $4.0 million, or $0.34 per share, on $115.2 million in revenues.
